description: This file defines the ContentDetailsController class, which manages the state and interactions related to content details in a Flutter application. It handles loading content data, updating watchlist status, playback progress, and download status, and interacts with repositories, cache, and database components.

classes.name: ContentDetailsController
classes.description: Controller managing the state and interactions for content details view in a Flutter app, including loading data, updating watchlist, playback progress, and download status.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches content details, watch progress, watchlist status, and download info, updating the controller state accordingly.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Adds or removes the current content to/from the watchlist stored in cache.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes content data from cache, mainly invoked on cache-buster events.

methods.name: playPressed
methods.description: Handles the play action, determines resume position, and updates playback progress.

methods.name: updateProgressSeconds
methods.description: Updates playback position and persists it via repository.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Legacy method for updating playback progress.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks the playback as completed and resets last watched position.

methods.name: markDownloadEnqueuedLocally
methods.description: Updates local download status immediately after enqueue.
